_note: Calibrated from the first fully-green run (2026-08-04, 143 checks / 0 failures, 50.3 min) at GRAND_OFFERS=25 with the batcher at 7 slots. Enforcement is baseline x 1.2. Re-calibrate for a different scale or a different box: these are wall-clock numbers and publishToIndexed is dominated by the celestia delayMs, not by node work. bookReadP95Ms raised 10 -> 20: with count=10 the p95 is effectively the max single read, and a lone 19ms read (p50 unmoved at 7-8ms) tripped the x1.2 gate on the 0.103.1 verification run. A real read-path regression moves the median, not one sample.
